configure_logger: configure a logger to write key-value diagnostics to stdout, log, csv, or json output formats
logkv_and_dumpkvs: log key-value pairs with logkv then flush all diagnostics to output files using dumpkvs
log_messages: write log messages at debug, info, warn, or error levels to configured output formats
profile_function: profile a function with the profile decorator to measure and log its execution time
scoped_configure: use scoped_configure context manager to temporarily switch logger directory and output formats
